units.source_text: 把3000元揣在怀里，一走出柏木的公寓，

en.t: With the 3,000 yuan tucked inside my coat, as soon as I left Kashiwagi's apartment,

units.source_text: 乘上电车，在船冈公园前下了车，

en.t: I boarded a streetcar and got off in front of Funaoka Park,

units.source_text: 爬上了通向建勋神社的迂回的石阶。

en.t: then climbed the winding stone steps that led to Kenkun Shrine.

units.source_text: 因为我想拍支神签，占卜旅途的平安。

en.t: I wanted to draw a fortune slip and divine whether my journey would be safe.
